Rural Health Access Fund

The Rural Health Access Fund supports community clinics and health nonprofits that expand primary care, behavioral health and dental access for residents of rural Washington counties.

Awards range up to $50,000 for a one-year project. Applications are due March 31, 2027.

Eligible applicants are 501(c)(3) organizations headquartered or operating in Chelan, Douglas, Okanogan or Grant counties.

Read the application guidelines (PDF) or frequently asked questions.
